title: Synergetic insights into Nb single atoms and lithiophilic support for high-efficiency sulfur catalysis in Li–S batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02048D, Paper
Yiyang Mao, Yan Zhang, Mingyu Su, Yanbin Ning, Jirui Shao, Kai Zhu, Shuaifeng Lou
A surface-active Li+ assisted LiPS conversion strategy is proposed. The *Li+-rich catalysts can accelerate LiPSs conversion through changing the Li+ attack pathway.
